results.scenario: Submit valid login credentials
results.expected: User is authenticated and redirected to the dashboard

results.scenario: Submit invalid login credentials
results.expected: Login is rejected with a validation error

results.scenario: Open the dashboard without signing in
results.expected: Visitor is redirected to the login page

results.scenario: Create a product with valid data
results.expected: Product is stored and appears in the product list

results.scenario: Submit an invalid product form
results.expected: Validation errors are returned and no record is saved

results.scenario: Complete a cash POS sale with available stock
results.expected: Order, items, receipt, payment and stock-out movement are created and stock is reduced
results.actual: Stock 12 to 10; receipt REC-2026-001 status paid; movement type sale recorded

results.scenario: Attempt to sell more than the available stock
results.expected: Checkout is rejected and stock and orders are unchanged
results.actual: HTTP 422; stock stays 6; orders unchanged at 6

results.scenario: Apply a 10 percent discount as an administrator
results.expected: Discount is calculated and the activity is logged

results.scenario: Apply a discount as a salesperson
results.expected: Request is rejected with an authorization error

results.scenario: Create an authorized credit sale with a part payment
results.expected: Receipt is partly paid with a due date and an outstanding balance
results.actual: Receipt REC-2026-003 amount 1070.00, paid 500.00, balance 570, status partial

results.scenario: Create a credit sale without a registered customer
results.expected: Request is rejected because a registered customer is required

results.scenario: Create a credit sale as a salesperson
results.expected: Request is rejected with an authorization error

results.scenario: Record a customer debt payment
results.expected: Payment is allocated to the open receipt and the balance is reduced

results.scenario: Pay more than the outstanding debt as a non-administrator
results.expected: Payment is rejected and the balance is unchanged

results.scenario: Record a purchase from a supplier
results.expected: Purchase is stored, product stock increases and the product cost is updated

results.scenario: Cancel a completed order
results.expected: Order status changes and stock is restored through a return movement
results.actual: HTTP 500; the database rejected the receipt status cancelled; order remained completed and stock stayed 10

results.scenario: Open reports with a date range
results.expected: Report page loads with totals for the selected period

results.scenario: Export a report
results.expected: CSV file is generated

results.scenario: Open user management as a non-administrator and as an administrator
results.expected: Non-administrator is denied and administrator is allowed

results.scenario: Record an operating expense
results.expected: Expense is stored with an expense number

results.scenario: Check how passwords are stored
results.expected: Passwords are stored as one-way hashes
results.actual: Stored value starts with $2y$12$ and has length 60

results.scenario: Submit a form without a CSRF token
results.expected: Request is rejected as expired or forged

results.scenario: Cancel an order that has no receipt
results.expected: Order status changes and stock is restored through a return movement
results.actual: Order status cancelled; stock 10 to 11; return movement recorded
